thread:
carmen-sales: ACME POC hit a 401 when they set X-Redwood-Org header after rotating keys. Without the header the same secret succeeds. Can we troubleshoot quickly?

drew-eng: Paste the sanitized curl and last 8 of key id pls.

carmen-sales: curl:
```
curl -s -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxxxxb7c8" -H "X-Redwood-Org: acme-inc" -d '{"prompt":"status"}'
```
Key suffix: b7c8e2f1. Response: `401 {"error":{"code":"invalid_key","message":"key not valid for requested org"}}`.

sophia-platform: Lookup shows sk-xxxxxxb7c8 is a personal key tied to a user workspace. When requests include X-Redwood-Org we enforce org-bound keys. We tightened this check in a recent authproxy deploy.

henry-se: That explains why it worked without header. Two remediation paths: 1) create an org-scoped API key in Console and update their server secret, or 2) remove the org header (temporary, not recommended for enterprise POCs).

carmen-sales: Customer also uses embeddings; will an org key be able to restrict to embeddings-only?

sophia-platform: Yes. Org keys can be created with scopes. If they pick embeddings-only and call /v1/generate they'll get `403 insufficient_scope`. Recommend creating an org key with required scopes for the POC (generate + embeddings if they need both).

drew-eng: I'll create a 24h ephemeral org key so they can validate during the call.

deploy-bot: created ephemeral key sk-org-ephem-3a9d (expires in 24h)

henry-se: I tested ephemeral key with both endpoints and headers; 200 for /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings.

carmen-sales: Scheduling a 20-min screen share to rotate and update k8s secret. Reminder to tell them: store keys server-side (K8s secrets/Vault), rotate via env rollout, revoke old keys after validation, and watch org quotas to avoid 429s during load tests.

sophia-platform: Also call out project header matching: if the key is project-scoped and they pass a different X-Redwood-Project they'll see `403 project_mismatch`. Slugs are exact and case-sensitive.

carmen-sales: Post-call update: they created an org key in Console, updated their secret in k8s, and validated both endpoints. They asked for a short best-practices note; I'll send one. Closing thread unless anything else shows up.
